body:
- **`count=` on `<Stat>`** — auto-formats numbers (thousands separator,
  currency, percent) based on a hint. Today authors format the string
  themselves.
- **Inline sparkline** — `<Stat trend-data="1,3,2,4,5,6">` renders a
  tiny inline sparkline (reuse datagrid's sparkline renderer).
- **Default `<ADR>` title = H1 child** — if `title=` isn't set, use the
  first H1 in children. Saves duplicating the title.
